SearchFormDefinition.Source: select ta.id,fg.functionalGroupId,fg.name,fg.type,im.itemNumber,im.description,cat.categoryName ,im.eol,site.siteDescription,ta.lastChangedOn,ta.lastChangedBy from TAMAllocation ta inner join ta.site site inner join ta.functionalGroup fg inner join fg.functionalGroupItems im inner join im.assignments ia inner join im.categories cat
SearchFormDefinition.ExtractSource: select ta.id,fg.functionalGroupId,fg.name,fg.type,im.itemNumber,im.description,cat.categoryName ,im.eol,site.siteDescription,ta.lastChangedOn,ta.lastChangedBy from TAMAllocation ta inner join ta.site site inner join ta.functionalGroup fg inner join fg.functionalGroupItems im inner join im.assignments ia inner join im.categories cat
